sentences.en: When she catches a cold, she often develops bronchitis.
sentences.zh: 她一感冒经常会引发支气管炎。

sentences.en: Have you ever been hospitalized for bronchitis or pneumonia?
sentences.zh: 你因为支气管炎或肺炎住过院吗？

sentences.en: Have you ever suffered from pulmonary tuberculosis, bronchial asthma or chronic bronchitis?
sentences.zh: 你得过分泌性肺结核、哮喘或是慢性支气管炎了吗？
